source_evidence: Exact player 'Mara get the cart back, team get ready for an attack' directs Mara to withdraw vehicle and companions to prepare combat, no specific V attack, movement or resource expenditure authorized yet. Both sides aware, no surprise/free preparation round. Actual executed RNG receipt batch70665934d28247b1b2f0e3964b4ae9b7: Savants15+2=17, Mara/coach15+0=15 (temporary noncombat vehicle-handling order modifier, not asserted Mara character Dex), Cirren11+2=13, Fenar9+2=11, V1+5=6, Derro3+2=5; identical enemy groups share initiative per 2014. Existing enclosed coach verified inventory.md D262/D264, so no automatic line of effect to enclosed passengers. Temporary geometry for execution from established coach center(0,0): solid coach body approx5ft wide/10ft long, no window line assumed to seated targets; coach west exit at(-5,0), dismount costs5ft movement. Horse team harnessed north ahead, Mara at reins. No damage to coach/horses, no unseen reinforcement. R1 savants initiative17: S1(65,60,z10) and S2(75,65,z10) each take Ready action, cast Lightning Bolt (one L3 slot each2→1, concentration holding spell, reaction available), S1 trigger first exposed hostile defender within100ft on clear line avoiding coach/horses; S2 trigger visible enemy spellcaster within100ft or two exposed defenders on clear line avoiding coach/horses. Their choice avoids damaging desired cargo, no line attack on occupants behind solid coach; if triggers not met before respective next turns, held spell expires with slot spent. S3 starts(70,80,z10), casts Invisibility on self (L2 3→2, concentration, invisible) and moves to(60,75,z10) along shaded rocky shelf, difficult terrain movement cost within30ft. V observes two casters gathering electrical energy and third disappears; exact ready triggers/hidden position DM-only. All seven enemies HP full; no roll for casting without target or self Invisibility. Mara initiative15 takes prepared controlled vehicle withdrawal when V and companions clear; holds reins, waits to avoid carrying party away; no actual vehicle movement yet. Temporary vehicle ruling: when all three dismounted, prepared withdrawal reaction begins cautious 10ft backing along open track (actual coach relocation only upon trigger; further turning/retreat on her turn), no full speed reverse dash or guaranteed safety. Cirren initiative13 dismounts west to(-10,0,z0), behind enclosed coach, shield, readies Toll the Dead on first hostile visible within60ft (concentration while holding cantrip, reaction available, no slot spent). No trigger during own or Fenar turn. Fenar initiative11 dismounts west to(-10,-5,z0), activates Rage (4→3/4), chooses Beast Claws, readies one claw attack if hostile enters5ft reach (action and reaction pending); no Shift/MP, no attack yet. Both behind coach with actual line blocked by solid body; no savant trigger yet. V initiative6 current turn, still inside coach, no action/BA/movement/reaction used, full stats, sword/Galepierce available; V chooses dismount/action. Four Derro D1(35,45,0), D2(35,65,0), D3(55,45,5), D4(55,65,5) initiative5 not yet acted. Enemy cover/light as previous: shade, D1/D2 half cover from coach, S1/S3 half cover from road (S3 invisible), S2 exposed, off-road difficult terrain. R1 elapsed within same 11:30; no rest, no expense, no supply use, no HP damage, no V resource expenditure.
